text: This item is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended. Area residents requested amendments to parking regulations on the west side of Hudson Drive, north of St. Clair Avenue East, to improve sight lines and safety for pedestrians. Prohibiting standing at all times on the west side of Hudson Drive, between a point 35 metres north of St. Clair Avenue East and a point 50 metres further north, will deter parking within close proximity of the bend in roadway and improve sight lines. Transportation Services' staff have no objections to the proposed amendments.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the west side of Hudson Drive, between a point 33 metres north of St. Clair Avenue East and a point 30 metres further north. 2. Prohibited standing at all times on the west side of Hudson Drive, between a point 35 metres north of St. Clair Avenue East and a point 50 metres further north.
